items.description: Learning or working on a new language/framework/library often requires referring to the official docs multiple times. With the rise of Static Site Generation (SSG) many documentation sites are now open-source and can be built for offline usage. This project aims to collect all such projects and the build commands to have a knowledge of widely used SSG tools.
